_comment: Controls what an external agent (Hermes, OpenClaw, or any other API client using an agent-labeled key) is allowed to do via /api/v1/agent/*. Master switch below must be true AND the specific capability must be true for a call to succeed. Nothing here affects the plain job-submission API (/api/v1/jobs) -- that has always been available to any valid API key.

search.description: Search recordings by description, topic, transcript, or person name. Read-only.

cameras_toggle.description: Enable or disable individual cameras. Does not change URLs or credentials.

pipeline_control.description: Start or stop the entire recording pipeline. Stopping it means no camera records until it's started again.

manual_trigger.description: Force-start a recording on a specific camera right now, and switch a camera between normal (auto-record) and notify-only (YOLO still detects, but only reports -- recording waits for an explicit trigger) mode. Creates real recordings and uses storage; off by default even though the other low-risk capabilities default on.

settings_change.description: Change detection/analysis tuning settings (confidence threshold, FPS, pre/post-roll, AI topics, thresholds). Restricted to a fixed allowlist of keys -- credentials, URLs, and export destinations can never be changed through this capability, regardless of this setting.

delete.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED YET. Would permanently delete recordings. Irreversible. Placeholder only -- no route exists for this capability.

export.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED YET. Would trigger export of recordings to the configured destination. Placeholder only -- no route exists for this capability.
